## Summary

Adds a new guide for using `Neo.timeline.Column` inside an existing Neo.mjs grid.

The guide covers:
- Setting up a grid with a Timeline Column.
- Connecting event records to resource rows.
- Configuring the time axis, ticks, snapping, and time zones.
- Working calendars and non-working-time shading.
- Bar styling, progress indicators, and drag/resize interactions.

Includes a complete runnable example based on the basic Timeline example.

Browser verification was completed successfully. Screenshots of the initial rendering and the one-hour interval shift are attached.
